turns.userText:
Build an offline selective header-compression engine.
Work in /workspace; Python 3.11.14 and its standard library are installed.
Read PROTOCOL.md for the complete byte format, lifecycle, and admission

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -R submission 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo "---"; ls

records.text: Now let me write the implementation.

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i "s/dict(mode='plan', caps=caps,/dict(mode='plan', capacities=caps,/" dev/test_plan.py && python3 dev/test_plan.py 2>&1 | tail -20

records.text: The DFS is correct but my recovery pass is heuristic/buggy. Let me rewrite the planner to snapshot the best solution during search.

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -i "s/capture_output=True)/capture_output=True,text=True)/" dev/bench.py && timeout 900 python3 dev/bench.py

records.name: bash
